title: Coffee before the meeting
transcript: Hey, I'm heading down to the cafe. Do you want anything? I'm going to grab a latte before the ten o'clock meeting. Oh, and I heard the meeting got pushed to ten thirty, so we have a bit more time.

questions.question: Where is the speaker going?
questions.explain_zh: 第一句 I'm heading down to the cafe 就說了要去咖啡店。

questions.question: What changed about the meeting?
questions.explain_zh: got pushed to ten thirty，push 在這裡是「延後」。

title: Checking in at the hotel
transcript: Good afternoon. I have a reservation under Chen, checking in for three nights. I requested a room on a high floor if that's still possible. Also, could you tell me what time breakfast is served?

questions.question: How many nights is the guest staying?
questions.explain_zh: 關鍵句是 checking in for three nights，check in for + 天數 就是住幾晚。

questions.question: What did the guest request?
options: A room on a high floor
questions.explain_zh: I requested a room on a high floor，request 比 want 正式，訂房時常用。

questions.question: What else did the guest ask about?
questions.explain_zh: what time breakfast is served，be served 是被動語態，指餐點「被供應」的時間。

title: Running late
transcript: Hi, it's me. I'm running about fifteen minutes late. The train was delayed. Go ahead and order without me, I'll have whatever you're having. Sorry about this.

questions.question: How late will the speaker be?
questions.explain_zh: running about fifteen minutes late。run late 是「進度落後」的固定用法，比 I will be late 自然。

questions.question: Why is the speaker late?
questions.explain_zh: The train was delayed。delay 當被動用，指交通工具誤點。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest?
questions.explain_zh: Go ahead and order without me。go ahead 是「你先做沒關係」的意思。

title: A quick project update
transcript: Quick update on the billing migration. We finished moving the customer records last Friday, which was two days ahead of schedule. The remaining work is mostly testing. I'd say we're about eighty percent done overall. The one risk is that we still haven't heard back from the payments team about the API changes.

questions.question: What is the status of the customer records?
questions.explain_zh: We finished moving the customer records last Friday，而且 two days ahead of schedule 是提前兩天，不是延遲。

questions.question: How far along is the project overall?
questions.explain_zh: about eighty percent done overall。overall 指整體進度，不是單一項目。

questions.question: What is the current risk?
options: No reply from the payments team
questions.explain_zh: we still haven't heard back from the payments team。haven't heard back 是「還沒收到回覆」。

title: Ordering at a restaurant
transcript: I'll start with the soup of the day. For the main course, does the pasta come with any meat? I'm vegetarian. If it does, I'll take the mushroom risotto instead. And just tap water is fine, thanks.

questions.question: What dietary restriction does the customer have?
questions.explain_zh: I'm vegetarian 直接說明是素食者，所以要避開肉類。

questions.question: What will the customer order if the pasta has meat?
questions.explain_zh: If it does, I'll take the mushroom risotto instead。instead 表示替代選擇。

questions.question: What did the customer order to drink?
questions.explain_zh: just tap water is fine，tap water 是免費的自來水。

title: Interview: tell me about yourself
transcript: Thanks for having me. I've been working in software development for about five years, mostly on backend systems. Most recently I led a small team that migrated our entire billing system, which took around eight months. What draws me to this role is the collaborative culture you described earlier.

questions.question: How many years of experience does the speaker have?
questions.explain_zh: I've been working in software development for about five years。現在完成進行式表示持續到現在。

questions.question: What was the speaker's most recent project?
questions.explain_zh: Most recently I led a small team that migrated our entire billing system。most recently 指最近一次。

questions.question: Why is the speaker interested in this role?
questions.explain_zh: What draws me to this role is... draw someone to 是「吸引某人」，後面接的就是原因。

title: Asking for directions
transcript: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the National Museum? Is it within walking distance, or should I take the subway? I've got about an hour before it closes.

questions.question: Where does the speaker want to go?
questions.explain_zh: how to get to the National Museum，get to 是「抵達某地」的常用說法。

questions.question: What is the speaker deciding between?
questions.explain_zh: Is it within walking distance, or should I take the subway，or 連接的就是兩個選項。

title: Declining an invitation politely
transcript: That sounds really fun, and I appreciate you thinking of me. Unfortunately I already have plans that evening. My sister's flying in from overseas and I promised I'd pick her up. Could we do something next weekend instead?

questions.question: Why can't the speaker attend?
questions.explain_zh: My sister's flying in from overseas and I promised I'd pick her up。fly in 指搭機抵達。

questions.question: What alternative does the speaker offer?
questions.explain_zh: Could we do something next weekend instead？用問句提出替代方案，語氣比較軟。

questions.question: How would you describe the speaker's tone?
questions.explain_zh: 先肯定對方、說明原因、再提替代方案，是很標準的禮貌婉拒結構。

title: A delayed flight
transcript: Attention passengers on flight BA two four seven to London. Due to a technical issue, departure has been delayed by approximately two hours. The new estimated departure time is nine forty. Passengers with connecting flights should speak to a member of staff at gate fourteen. We apologize for the inconvenience.

questions.question: How long is the flight delayed?
questions.explain_zh: delayed by approximately two hours，approximately 等於 about，是廣播常用的正式說法。

questions.question: What is the new estimated departure time?
questions.explain_zh: The new estimated departure time is nine forty，也就是九點四十分。estimated 表示只是預估。

questions.question: What should passengers with connecting flights do?
questions.explain_zh: speak to a member of staff at gate fourteen。注意 fourteen（14）和 forty（40）發音容易混淆。

title: Negotiating a deadline
transcript: I want to be upfront with you about the timeline. Delivering everything by the end of the month is technically possible, but I'm not confident we could do it thoroughly. If we can push the deadline back by one week, I'd feel much better about the quality. Alternatively, we could ship the core features on time and follow up with the rest.

questions.question: What does the speaker think about delivering by month end?
options: Technically possible but quality is a concern
questions.explain_zh: technically possible, but I'm not confident we could do it thoroughly。but 之後才是真正的重點。

questions.question: What is the speaker's first proposal?
options: Push the deadline back one week
questions.explain_zh: If we can push the deadline back by one week，push back 是把期限往後推的固定用法。

questions.question: What is the alternative proposal?
options: Ship core features on time and follow up with the rest
questions.explain_zh: Alternatively 之後接的就是第二方案：ship the core features on time and follow up with the rest。

title: A voicemail from the dentist
transcript: Hi, this is Karen calling from Bright Smile Dental. I'm ringing to confirm your appointment on Thursday the fourteenth at three fifteen. If you need to reschedule, please give us a call at least twenty-four hours in advance. Otherwise we'll see you then. Thanks!

questions.question: When is the appointment?
questions.explain_zh: Thursday the fourteenth at three fifteen，注意 fifteen（15）和 fifty（50）發音容易混。

questions.question: How far in advance should you call to reschedule?
questions.explain_zh: at least twenty-four hours in advance，in advance 是「事先」。

title: Ordering coffee to go
transcript: Hi, can I get a large oat milk latte to go? And could you make it extra hot? Oh, and hold the sugar, please. Actually, do you have any of those almond croissants left? I'll take one of those as well.

questions.question: What kind of milk does the customer want?
questions.explain_zh: a large oat milk latte，oat milk 是燕麥奶。

questions.question: What does 'hold the sugar' mean?
questions.explain_zh: hold the + 食材 是「不要加」，點餐常用。

questions.question: What else does the customer order?
questions.explain_zh: I'll take one of those as well，指前面提到的 almond croissants。

title: Gym membership enquiry
transcript: Our standard membership is forty-five a month with no lock-in contract. That gets you access to the gym floor and all group classes. If you want to add personal training, that's an extra thirty per session. We're open five thirty in the morning until eleven at night on weekdays, and eight to eight on weekends.

questions.question: How much is the standard membership?
questions.explain_zh: forty-five a month，a month 等於 per month。

questions.question: What does 'no lock-in contract' mean?
questions.explain_zh: lock-in contract 是有綁約期的合約，no lock-in 表示可隨時取消。

questions.question: When does the gym close on weekends?
questions.explain_zh: eight to eight on weekends，週末是早八到晚八。

title: Weekend plans falling through
transcript: So we were supposed to go hiking on Saturday, but the forecast says heavy rain all weekend. I'd rather not get soaked halfway up a mountain. I was thinking we could push it to next weekend instead, or if you're keen to do something, there's that new exhibition at the museum. Let me know either way.

questions.question: Why is the plan changing?
questions.explain_zh: the forecast says heavy rain all weekend，forecast 是天氣預報。

questions.question: What are the two options offered?
options: A different trail or a movie
questions.explain_zh: push it to next weekend instead, or... that new exhibition，or 連接兩個方案。

questions.question: What does 'push it to next weekend' mean?
questions.explain_zh: push something to + 時間 是「延到某時」。

title: Standup meeting update
transcript: Quick update from me. Yesterday I finished the login refactor and got it merged. Today I'm picking up the password reset flow, which should take most of the day. One blocker: I'm still waiting on design to send over the final mockups for the error states. If those don't land by this afternoon I'll move on to something else.

questions.question: What did the speaker finish yesterday?
questions.explain_zh: I finished the login refactor and got it merged，merge 是把程式碼合併進主分支。

questions.question: What is blocking the speaker?
questions.explain_zh: waiting on design to send over the final mockups，blocker 指擋住進度的事。

questions.question: What will the speaker do if the mockups are late?
questions.explain_zh: I'll move on to something else，move on to 是轉去做別的。

title: Requesting time off
transcript: I wanted to give you plenty of notice. I'm hoping to take the week of the twelfth off. I know that's close to the release, so I've already spoken to Marcus and he's happy to cover the deployment. I'll also make sure all my handover notes are written up before I go.

questions.question: When does the speaker want time off?
questions.explain_zh: the week of the twelfth，the week of + 日期 表示那一週。

questions.question: Who will cover the deployment?
questions.explain_zh: I've already spoken to Marcus and he's happy to cover，cover 是代班。

questions.question: What does the speaker promise to do first?
questions.explain_zh: make sure all my handover notes are written up，handover 是交接。

title: Checking out of a hotel
transcript: Good morning. I'm checking out of room four-oh-nine. Before you run the card, could you just talk me through these two charges? There's one for the minibar, which I don't think I used, and another one labelled service fee. Also, would it be possible to leave my bags here until about four this afternoon?

questions.question: What does the guest question?
questions.explain_zh: talk me through these two charges，talk someone through 是「逐項說明給某人聽」。

questions.question: What does the guest also ask for?
questions.explain_zh: leave my bags here until about four，飯店寄放行李的標準說法。

title: Reporting a lost item
transcript: I think I left my laptop bag on the number forty bus. I got off at the central station stop at around six fifteen this evening. It's a dark grey backpack with a red luggage tag on the handle. There's a laptop inside and, more importantly, my passport. Is there anything you can do?

questions.question: Where was the bag left?
questions.explain_zh: I left my laptop bag on the number forty bus，number forty 是公車路線號碼。

questions.question: How is the bag described?
options: Dark grey with a red tag
questions.explain_zh: a dark grey backpack with a red luggage tag。描述失物要具體，這是實用的句型。

questions.question: What matters most to the speaker?
questions.explain_zh: more importantly, my passport，more importantly 標示出重點。

title: Describing a weakness
transcript: Honestly, I used to take on too much. I'd say yes to everything because I wanted to be helpful, and then I'd be stretched too thin to do any of it properly. What's helped is being more deliberate about it. Now when someone asks, I'll check what's already on my plate before committing.

questions.question: What weakness does the speaker describe?
questions.explain_zh: I used to take on too much，take on 是承接任務。

questions.question: What does 'stretched too thin' mean?
options: Having too much to do well
questions.explain_zh: stretched too thin 是「分身乏術」，事情多到每件都做不好。

questions.question: How has the speaker addressed it?
questions.explain_zh: check what's already on my plate before committing，on my plate 是手上的工作量。

title: A package delivery notice
transcript: We attempted to deliver your parcel today at two forty but nobody was home. We've left it with your neighbour at number twelve. If that's not convenient, you can arrange a redelivery online using the reference number on the card. Please note that we can only hold parcels for seven days.

questions.question: What happened to the parcel?
options: It was left with a neighbour
It was left at the door
questions.explain_zh: left it with your neighbour at number twelve，number twelve 是門牌號碼。

questions.question: How long will they hold parcels?
questions.explain_zh: 關鍵句是 we can only hold parcels for seven days，hold 在這裡是「代為保管」。

title: Feedback in a one-on-one
transcript: Overall I think you've had a strong quarter. The migration project in particular went far more smoothly than I expected. One thing I'd like you to work on is speaking up earlier when something's going off track. You flagged the database issue eventually, but had we known a week earlier we'd have had a lot more options.

questions.question: What does the manager praise?
questions.explain_zh: went far more smoothly than I expected，far more 用來加強比較級，語氣比 much more 更強。

questions.question: What should the employee improve?
questions.explain_zh: speaking up earlier when something's going off track，speak up 是把問題講出來。

questions.question: What does 'going off track' mean?
questions.explain_zh: off track 是偏離軌道，指事情沒照計畫走。

title: Explaining a delay to a client
transcript: I want to be straight with you about where we are. The core functionality is complete and tested. However, the integration with your payment provider has thrown up some issues that were outside what we anticipated. Realistically we're looking at an additional two weeks. I'd rather tell you that now than promise a date we can't hit.

questions.question: What is already complete?
questions.explain_zh: The core functionality is complete and tested，core functionality 指核心功能，是專案溝通的常用詞。

questions.question: How much extra time is needed?
questions.explain_zh: we're looking at an additional two weeks，we're looking at 是「預計會是」。

questions.question: What is the speaker's reasoning for telling the client now?
options: To avoid promising an unrealistic date
questions.explain_zh: rather tell you that now than promise a date we can't hit，hit a date 是趕上期限。

title: Boarding gate change
transcript: This is an announcement for passengers travelling to Singapore on flight SQ two two six. Please note that this flight will now depart from gate thirty-two, not gate twenty-three as previously announced. Boarding will begin in approximately fifteen minutes. Passengers requiring assistance should make themselves known to a member of staff.

questions.question: Which gate should passengers go to?
questions.explain_zh: gate thirty-two, not gate twenty-three。這兩個數字很容易聽混，是廣播聽力的典型考點。

questions.question: When does boarding start?
questions.explain_zh: Boarding will begin in approximately fifteen minutes，in + 時間 表示「再過多久」，不是「在…之內」。

title: Talking about a career change
transcript: I spent six years in finance before moving into data analysis. It wasn't a sudden decision. I'd been doing more and more reporting work, and I found I enjoyed the analytical side far more than the client-facing side. So I took a course in the evenings, built a few projects, and eventually made the switch about eighteen months ago.

questions.question: What was the speaker's previous field?
questions.explain_zh: I spent six years in finance，spend + 時間 + in + 領域 是描述資歷的常見句型。

questions.question: What did the speaker enjoy more?
questions.explain_zh: enjoyed the analytical side far more than the client-facing side，client-facing 指「直接面對客戶」的工作。

questions.question: How did the speaker prepare for the change?
options: Took evening courses and built projects
questions.explain_zh: took a course in the evenings, built a few projects，說明轉職準備的具體行動，面試談轉職時很受用的講法。
